## Today's Today's Market Analysis

TODAY, 3:39p ET: Risk-off sentiment prevails as semiconductor weakness weighs on the tape despite micro-cap biotech surges. SDOT leads gainers, climbing +244% on massive volume; IVF jumps +113% following a strategic 8-K filing. PSIG collapses -87% as the top loser; CELZ drops -42% after filing a new S-1 registration statement for a securities offering.(more...)

## Tape Overview

Equities exhibit a bifurcated session as heavy selling in semiconductors offsets aggressive speculative flows into micro-cap healthcare and ag-tech names.

## Top Mover: Sadot Group Inc. (SDOT) — Leading the tape on massive volume

Sadot Group Inc. (SDOT) surged**+244.7%** on 42.6M shares as momentum traders swarmed the low-float name. This move represents a significant breakout from recent consolidation levels during regular trading hours.

## Top Loser: PS International Group Ltd. (PSIG) — Massive sell-off on high volume

PS International Group Ltd. (PSIG) plummeted **-87.7%** as the stock hit session lows on 15.3M shares. The aggressive liquidation follows a period of heightened volatility, marking a total reversal of recent gains.

## Also Moving

INVO Fertility, Inc. (IVF) spiked**+113.2%** on a 195x volume surge following a recent 8-K filing. Creative Medical Technology Holdings, Inc. (CELZ) fell**-42.0%** after filing an S-1 registration, while Micron Technology, Inc. (MU) dragged the tech sector down**-5.7%** on $56B in dollar volume.

## Broader Context

Traders are monitoring if the weakness in mega-cap tech like MU and NVDA will trigger a broader index correction or a rotation into laggard sectors.
